in_marathi.name: Bhuriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhuriya is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Bhagiratha', who was an ancient king in Hindu mythology. This name is associated with Lord Indra, the god of rain, and the goddess of cows, Kamadhenu. Bhuriya symbolizes strength, abundance, and protection. The name is often given to girls to bless them with prosperity, fertility, and nourishment.
